title: Recapitulation of pathophysiological features of AD in SARS-CoV-2-infected subjects

planted.description: Added the scope "in every population and setting" before the citation
planted.original: Previous evidence tentatively suggests that SARS-CoV-2 may be neuroinvasive, leading to a vast array of neurological symptoms, including anosmia, ageusia, cognitive functions, and cerebrovascular disorders (Desforges et al., 2014; Hingorani et al., 2022).
